requirement_text: The app must load fully and be ready for use within a maximum of two seconds after starting, on supported devices.
requirement_reference: "the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."

user_story.story: As a mobile user, I want the app to launch promptly so that I can access features without waiting.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I open the app,
When the startup process begins,
Then the app must be ready for use within two seconds.

requirement_text: All app modules and the user interface must remain consistent in their design and functionality, even if the external server is updated.
requirement_reference: "All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates."

user_story.story: As a user, I want the app interface and modules to not break or change unexpectedly when servers are updated so that my usage experience is stable.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given the external server receives an update,
When I use the app,
Then the core UI elements and modules should remain unchanged.

requirement_text: The app must function reliably and maintain usability even under conditions of limited network coverage.
requirement_reference: "the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage."

user_story.story: As a user in a low-connectivity area, I want the app to work so that I do not lose access to features unexpectedly.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I have poor network coverage,
When I use core app features,
Then the features must remain available and function as expected.

requirement_text: The app must remain usable offline, allowing access to previously loaded data, even if network connectivity is temporarily lost.
requirement_reference: "The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to keep using the app and access loaded information even when I'm offline so that my experience is uninterrupted.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I'm using the app,
When I lose my network connection,
Then I can still access previously loaded data and features.

requirement_text: The app must be able to serve up to 100,000 users simultaneously during high-traffic periods such as match days without any noticeable performance loss.
requirement_reference: "our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."

user_story.story: As an operator, I want the app to support large numbers of users so that the experience is reliable on busy match days.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given 100,000 users are using the app concurrently,
When the system is operating at peak load,
Then users do not experience slowdowns or downtime.

requirement_text: The app must undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early.
requirement_reference: "the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."

user_story.story: As a QA engineer, I want the app thoroughly tested before release so that users receive a stable product.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given the app is prepared for release,
When the testing is complete,
Then no known critical defects remain and the app is stable.

requirement_text: All processing of users' personal data must be performed in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
requirement_reference: "All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."

user_story.story: As a user, I want assurance that my personal data is handled lawfully so that my privacy is protected.
user_story.Acceptance:
Given I use the app and provide personal data,
When it is processed,
Then it must be processed according to GDPR regulations.
